Eloise (CS): Quick thread to build a short customer-facing 'momentum' playbook for prefetch vs on-demand. want something crisp for kickoff emails + an ops checklist.
Kofi (Solutions): Make it a single page: recommended defaults, one tiny YAML, a heartbeat smoke test command, and a 3-question pulse for week1.
Jun (Eng): Add a note about staged rollout: small warm pool at go-live, expand after 72h if hit rate >30%. include key names for telemetry.
Eloise (CS): Draft bullets: 1) Use prefetch when you have a high-value, repeatable prompt set (default TTL conservative = 1h). 2) On-demand (lazy) for exploratory UX; pair with client debounce 120ms. 3) Streaming only for long responses or live typing; avoid for sub-120-token classification calls. 4) Staged warm pool: start 6 entries, grow to 30 over 72h if reuse is high.
Rosa (PM): Add renewal/health signals: 3-week rolling engagement drop >30% -> CSM outreach; missed heartbeat smoke test 2x -> SE triage; week1 pulse response rate <12% -> AE follow-up.
Kofi (Solutions): Paste-friendly YAML snippet we can hand to customers:
```yaml
momentum_defaults:
  prefetch_enabled: true
  prefetch_ttl_s: 3600
  warm_pool_initial: 6
  warm_pool_target: 30
  client_debounce_ms: 120
  server_batch_max_wait_ms: 60
  streaming_threshold_tokens: 260
```
Jun (Eng): Telemetry keys to capture: prefill.hit_count, prefill.miss_count, warm_pool_hit_rate, batch.size_p95_ms, stream.open_count. Recommend alert: warm_pool_miss_rate > 7% for 15m.
Eloise (CS): Week1 pulse copy (one line): "Quick 3: 1) Relevance 1-5 2) Latency OK? (y/n) 3) Anything blocking? (one short line)" send at day 7.
Kofi (Solutions): Heartbeat smoke test customers can run after go-live (one-liner):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{tenant}/healthcheck" | jq '.status, .prefill_hit_rate'
```
Jun (Eng): Dev notes (short): - KV cache key: tenant|env|prompt_sha|schema_v. - Batch window tradeoff: 25-70ms favors latency; 70-200ms favors cost. - Streaming keeps sockets open and increases per-request CPU; best for interactive typing or responses >250 tokens.
Eloise (CS): Recovery checklist (3 bullets): 1) If stale outputs after content/model update: bump schema_v and flush warm pool. 2) If warm_pool_miss spike: temporarily raise server_batch_max_wait_ms to 120ms and run a backfill job. 3) If p95 latency >2x baseline: reduce batch window, or switch to dedicated capacity.
